title: artifact-seed-v1
description: The seed.json member of an artifact package whose handoff plans a planted item: the text to plant in the target's records before the run, and where. Each item names a seed slot of the runtime contract the package was authored against, one of that slot's records, and that slot's mode. The slot's max_chars bounds content; this schema cannot see the slot, so it states no length limit.

carrier_operation.description: The operation whose result returns the planted text to the agent: the slot's carrier_operation.

slot.description: The id of the runtime contract's seed slot.

record_ref.description: The record whose field holds the text: one of the slot's records.

mode.description: How the target writes the text into the field: the slot's mode.

content.description: The planted text, at most the slot's max_chars characters.
